svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400GE QSFP-DD OpenZR+/ZR/ER4/LR4/SR8/FR4/DR4/DR4+/PLR4; 200GE QSFP56 SR4/FR4; 100GE QSFP28 ZR4/ER4/LR4/SR4 (datasheet compatible transceiver list)
svg.data-zr-capacity: up to 32 QSFP-DD ZR+ modules; the HIG's Figure 12 shades one 32-port band to mark which ports they are - see the zr-port-set gap
svg.data-timing-cable: SMB coaxial with a 10-32UNF-2A connector, for 1PPS and 10MHz
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 plus a micro-USB serial console
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; BSMI (CNS 13438), Class A; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A

circle.data-description: HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (no input power), Solid Green (fan is functioning normal), Solid Yellow (fan is abnormal, service is required)
HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (no input power), Solid Green (fan is functioning normal), Solid Yellow (fan is abnormal, service is required)
HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (no input power), Solid Green (fan is functioning normal), Solid Yellow (fan is abnormal, service is required)
HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (no input power), Solid Green (fan is functioning normal), Solid Yellow (fan is abnormal, service is required)

HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no input power to all power supplies), Solid Green (output ON and OK), Blinking Green (input power present / only +12VSB on; the 2 Hz firmware-updating row is visually identical and shares this state), Solid Amber (input out of range with a second supply in parallel still fed, and separately a critical event causing shutdown - OTP, OVP, UVP, OCP), Blinking Amber at 1 Hz (warning events where the supply keeps operating - high temp, high power, high current, slow fan)

HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no input power to all power supplies), Solid Green (output ON and OK), Blinking Green (input power present / only +12VSB on; the 2 Hz firmware-updating row is visually identical and shares this state), Solid Amber (input out of range with a second supply in parallel still fed, and separately a critical event causing shutdown - OTP, OVP, UVP, OCP), Blinking Amber at 1 Hz (warning events where the supply keeps operating - high temp, high power, high current, slow fan)
